description: SARS (and CIPC) due dates in a date range: EMP201 (7th, earlier when that is a weekend or public holiday), VAT201 by VAT category A–E (eFiling: last business day of the month after the period), provisional tax IRP6, EMP501 reconciliation windows, ITR14 and CIPC annual returns. Uses South African public holidays.

incorporation_date.description: Companies/CCs: YYYY-MM-DD, for the CIPC annual return

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default 3 months after from; at most 2 years)

vat_category.description: VAT category: A = 2-monthly ending odd months, B = 2-monthly ending even months, C = monthly, D = 6-monthly, E = annual; none (default) = not VAT registered

vat_period_end_month.description: Category D/E only: month (1-12) a period ends

year_end_month.description: Financial year-end month 1-12 (default 2 = February, the individual tax year)

name: sa_tax_calendar
title: South African tax due dates
